explanation: The theorem describes the image of a continuous character χ of a one-relator pro-p group into ℤ_[p]ˣ that has the prescription property. It says the image lies in the principal units of level k exactly when p^k divides every exponent sum of the relator r. Everything in it comes from the library itself: free pro-p groups, presented pro-p groups, `exponentSum`, the prescription property and crossed homomorphisms. I grepped the Mathlib sources for `freeProP`, `ProP` and `exponentSum` and got no matches, so Mathlib has no free or presented pro-p groups and nothing it could duplicate. The proof also uses only library lemmas, not a single Mathlib result.
